notes.title: 🛠️ Bearskull – Final Update | Changelog for the 2-Year Anniversary
notes.content:
[b]Hello dear Bearskull friends,[/b]

To celebrate Bearskull’s 2nd anniversary, we’ve prepared a very special and final update for you. Here’s a detailed look at all the new features and improvements:

[b]📖 Story Continuation[/b]
The story no longer ends with the Sorkin battle – it now continues beyond that! Look forward to new dialogues, fresh events, and an exciting new chapter in the Bearskull universe.

[b]👑 Sorkin Boss Fight Rework[/b]
The fight against Sorkin has been completely redesigned and now consists of three dynamic phases. Each phase introduces new mechanics and challenges – an epic boss fight awaits you!

[b]🛡️ New Shield Feature[/b]
At the beginning of the game, you now receive a protective shield that allows you to block enemy attacks. This new element adds depth to the gameplay and gives you more tactical options.

[b]🌍 Overworld Enhancements[/b]
The Overworld has been slightly adjusted and optimized to make exploration smoother and more immersive. Small visual improvements and pathing updates enhance the experience.

[b]🖥️ Improved User Interface (UI)[/b]
The user interface has been revamped to feel cleaner, clearer, and more intuitive. Menus, HUD elements, and interactions have been polished to make your experience more enjoyable.

[b]🎬 Bonus Cutscene[/b]
A hidden bonus cutscene can now be unlocked – perfect for those who love uncovering secrets and diving deeper into the Bearskull lore.

[b]🏆 New Achievements[/b]
Three new achievements have been added! Are you up for the challenge to collect them all?

[b]🚀 Performance Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Reduced loading times.
[*] Better stability on lower-end hardware.
[*] General FPS improvements.
[*] Minor bugs fixed.
[/list]

Your adventure should now run noticeably smoother!

Thank you so much for two amazing years of support, feedback, and enthusiasm!
This update is our way of saying thank you –[b] and there’s another exciting announcement coming later today, so stay tuned![/b]

Let’s celebrate 2 years of Bearskull together! 🎉

notes.title: The Final Chapter of Bearskull: The Big Update is Coming!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Bearskull Community,[/b]

After an intense and passionate development phase, it's finally here: We are in the final testing phase of the major Bearskull update! We've spent almost a year working to make the finale even more captivating, expand the story with exciting new content, and add fresh features. Our goal was to create an experience that excites us and you 100% – and we are proud of how far we've come.

[b]🎯 Planned Release: March 2025[/b]

This update marks a significant milestone: an epic finale that gives Bearskull a worthy conclusion. But don't worry, this doesn't mean the end of this world. On the contrary: at the end of the update, you'll find the first teaser for Bearskull 2! Yes, we promised it – and soon it will finally be here.

[b]🔍 Why did it take so long?[/b]
We are a passionate team of students who, in addition to Bearskull, work on several smaller games you can also find here on Steam. Despite our limited time, we've invested every free minute into this update – with a huge amount of heart and creativity.

[b]💥 What can you expect?[/b]

[list]
[*] A redesigned finale with unexpected twists.
[*] Expanded story content that delves deeper into the world of Bearskull.
[*] New gameplay elements and optimized mechanics for even more fun.
[/list]

We are incredibly excited to finally share the result of our work with you soon. Thank you for your patience, support, and enthusiasm, which constantly motivates us.

[u]Get ready – the Bearskull era continues![/u]

Your Bearskull Team 🐻💀

notes.title: Bearskull – The Final Update
notes.content:
[b]Hey dear Bearskull friends![/b]

It's been a while since we last checked in, and many of you have asked if the game is now finally complete. The short answer: No. Since the last update, we've been working hard on a final major update for Bearskull that will bring some exciting new content:

[list]
[*] New levels
[*] A new boss
[*] An arena mode
[*] A story expansion
[*] And much more
[/list]

But the journey doesn't end there. Those familiar with DreamStudios know that we keep our promises. And yes, there will be a sequel, and it will be amazing. While we can't reveal too much just yet, the final update will give you a glimpse of the direction Bearskull 2 will take. More details will follow, but rest assured, development is already underway.

Before Bearskull 2 is released, however, we have a little surprise in store for you. So, get excited for what's to come with Bearskull! In the meantime, feel free to check out our other games, as we're not just focused on one project – our team has grown significantly.

[i]We thank you, your[/i]
Dreamstudios

notes.title: Bearskull - Quality of life Update 2
notes.content:
[b]Hey dear Bearskull friends![/b]

We received a little feedback again and we have implemented this with the new update. Please take a look at it and give us feedback on it. We look forward to seeing each and every one of you!

Not only have we fixed minor changes and bugs, but we've also added a little something new: there are now boxes that block your way; you can destroy them with your sword.

Here is the changelog:

-Destroy boxes with your sword (you can now destroy boxes on the map with your sword)
-New Achievement (Mystery Box)

-Dialog errors (a few dialogs were missing in English)
-Overworld shops (we swapped the shops in the overworld so that you can get new ones sooner
  can buy weapons)

-Speedrun Contest graphics replaced

Feel free to write us your wishes on our [url=https://discord.gg/33AssN7jsJ]Discord Server[/url]

notes.title: Bearskull - Speedrun Contest
notes.content:
[b]Hey dear Bearskull friends![/b]

After recently releasing the major Bearskull Content Update, we are excited to launch our first official event!

Our goal is to determine who knows the levels best, who may have discovered a trick or two to be faster, and who has played the game the most.

Of course, we don't want to leave this unrewarded. The winners will be immortalized in the game through a winner's banner, featuring their names.

To participate, simply record a video of your speedrun. In-game sound or your own audio is not necessary. It's best to upload the video on YouTube. Whether it's listed or not is up to you. However, you should CLEARLY (in the title or description) indicate the difficulty level of the gameplay. Applications for multiple difficulty levels are not possible.

Then, apply easily through our Discord in the designated channel or via our Google Docs. Simply enter the link to your video in the corresponding field, provide the remaining details, and submit the form. And there you are, nominated for the Speedrun Contest.

You can apply until 29.12.2023. Subsequently, we will evaluate all submissions and announce the winners in the respective difficulty levels.


Google Docs: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe1DZ8TU0Ryscl8KE1bAHlYZeyVRljrwr44ZzfF6kkLu-2ccA/viewform] for registration[/url]
Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/ETqVEe6b8X]Link[/url]

[i]We thank you, your[/i]
Dreamstudios

notes.title: Bearskull - Quality of life Update
notes.content:
[b]Dear Bearskull friends[/b]

We’ve now made a few changes so we can provide you better gaming experience. Since many have asked for a WASD control, we’ve added it for you to test, and we are exited ro receive your feedback

We are very happy that Bearskull is so well received by you, so I can now announce that we are currently working on a content update, we are very excited to get your feedback on this in the future.

Here is the changelog:

-WASD control was added as a test (mouse control is still recommended)
-Dialog adverts are now transparent
-Low life is now displayed graphically
-A full inventory is now displayed graphically
-World glitches have been fixed
-Fixed collision bugs
-The mini-boss now closes the door behind you
-Now enemies can’t be pushed away after death

Feel free to write us your wishes on our [url=https://discord.gg/33AssN7jsJ]Discord Server[/url]


[i]We thank you, your[/i]
dream studio

notes.title: Bearskull - Supporter Package
notes.content:
[b]Dear Bearskull friends[/b]

First of all we want to thank you all.
We received a lot of positive feedback and saw numerous reviews, YouTube videos, and streams from you. That gives us great pleasure!

Of course, we have also received feedback on things that you would like to have improved, which we will of course also work on, we have made a large list that we have taken from the Steam ratings and the content that has been published by you.

We also stand by our word and will develop a successor to Bearskull.

Since some wrote to us and asked how you can support us apart from a Steam rating, we have now released a supporter DLC, which you can buy for about 5 euros, currently there is no extra content in there, but we will do so in the future after patching, because we prefer to focus on the main game at the moment.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2410830/Bearskull__Supporter_Package/

We work very hard on our projects and want to offer you cool games and above all we want to listen to your feedback.

[i]Thank you[/i]
dream studio
